brief:
Middle East Eye documented inflammatory statements from incoming Israeli MPs, including one who described babies in Gaza as enemies. The appointments represent a significant shift toward the political far-right in Israel's governing coalition, with several newly elected lawmakers holding openly hostile positions toward Palestinian civilians and questioning the legitimacy of Palestinian existence.

The outlet reviewed public statements and positions held by the incoming legislators, revealing a pattern of dehumanizing language directed at Palestinians. Their entry into parliament signals the influence of far-right ideology on Israel's legislative agenda and policy direction.
title: Israeli far-right MPs take office with inflammatory rhetoric on Palestinians
